title: Izzy B Vacation Rental
meta_description: Izzy B is a 7.00 bedroom, 7.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to Izzy B, a breathtaking seven-bedroom estate in WaterColor’s Park District, just one block from the Boathouse Pool and a short walk to the Beach Club and Gulf. Designed for luxury, comfort, and togetherness, this 4,400-square-foot retreat offers elegant coastal style, a private saltwater pool, and a carriage house, perfect for large families and group getaways.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 16 Passes Included 6 Adult Bikes Included Parking for 4 Vehicles (Garage Access Available) One Block to the Boathouse Pool Gourmet Kitchen Outside Covered Patio and Balconies Exterior Shower Natural Gas Grill Private Saltwater Pool with Jacuzzi Jets (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1 – May 1) Surround Sound on Main Floor and Outdoor Courtyard Private Entrance Near Garage to Carriage House and Main House via Shared Courtyard and Wet Bar with Mini Fridge and Ice Maker 2 Sets of Washers and Dryers 3-Minute Walk to WaterColor Beach Club and Beach Access 3-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Central Square Experience the Home Perfectly positioned near Western Lake and WaterColor’s Beach Club, Izzy B combines timeless craftsmanship with relaxed coastal living. The open-concept main floor welcomes guests with oak floors, white shiplap walls, and rustic beams. The living area flows into a beautifully appointed chef’s kitchen featuring Calcutta marble countertops, high-end appliances, a wine cooler, and a large center island designed for gathering. The adjoining dining area seats eight comfortably around a farmhouse-style table. The first floor includes two elegant king bedrooms with private bathrooms, a powder room, and convenient access to the outdoor spaces. Upstairs, the second-floor master suite serves as a serene private retreat with a king bed, private balcony, double vanity, steam shower, soaking tub, and a dedicated office nook with a wet bar. Two additional bunk rooms, each sleeping four, include private bathrooms and cheerful coastal décor. A full laundry area completes this level. On the third floor, a cozy media room and common area provide an excellent space for relaxation or entertainment. This floor also features a guest bedroom with two full beds and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, offering ideal accommodations for teens or extended family. The private Chicago-brick courtyard is the heart of the property, complete with a sparkling saltwater pool, soothing waterfall feature, and jacuzzi jets. A covered patio with outdoor seating, a fireplace, surround sound, and a natural gas grill make this space perfect for gathering and entertaining. Across the courtyard, the carriage house offers additional privacy and comfort, featuring a king bedroom, private bathroom, living area, and full kitchen. With six adult bikes included, exploring WaterColor, Seaside, and the 30A area is effortless. Izzy B delivers the perfect balance of sophistication, space, and resort-style comfort for unforgettable coastal living.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Half Bathroom Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Over Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Over Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Washer and Dryer Third Floor Guest Bedroom: Two Full Beds (Sleeps 4), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Carriage House Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Living Area Kitchen Life in WaterColor Located in WaterColor’s highly sought-after Park District, Izzy B places guests' steps from Western Lake, the Boathouse Pool, and the WaterColor Beach Club. Enjoy scenic walks, relaxing bike rides, and easy access to Seaside’s Central Square for dining and shopping. Whether lounging by the private saltwater pool or entertaining on the courtyard patio, every detail of this home is crafted for luxurious comfort and effortless coastal living. Guests may rent a cart exclusively through The Electric Cart Company. Please note that WaterColor allows only one electric cart per home, and rentals are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Advance reservations are strongly recommended, especially during peak seasons.
